LOCAL PRICE-LABEL OCR — THIRD-PARTY NOTICES

Tesseract.js 7.0.0
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
Apache License 2.0: TESSERACT-JS-LICENSE.txt
The browser distributions are unmodified. Their bundled third-party notices are
retained in tesseract.min.js.LICENSE.txt and worker.min.js.LICENSE.txt.

Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
Apache License 2.0: TESSERACT-CORE-LICENSE.txt
All six unmodified embedded-WASM browser builds are included: scalar, SIMD, and
relaxed-SIMD, each with full and LSTM-only variants. The worker chooses the
appropriate build for the device. Source maps and separate raw-WASM builds are
omitted because the browser loader uses self-contained .wasm.js variants.

English trained model
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast
Copied unmodified from the installed tesseract-ocr-eng language package.
Apache License 2.0: TESSDATA-LICENSE.txt
Installed distribution attribution: ENG-MODEL-COPYRIGHT.txt.

Korean trained model — MODIFIED FILE
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best
The official kor.traineddata model downloaded on 2026-11-21 was converted to an
integer LSTM network with the official combine_tessdata 5.5.0 utility (-c).
This compacted model supports the bundled browser core. It was not retrained.
Apache License 2.0: TESSDATA-LICENSE.txt

PROVENANCE.json records exact hashes, byte sizes, sources, and the conversion.
ocr-engine.js and label-worker.js are this application's integration code.
Photos are processed in the browser. Runtime/model requests contain no photo
pixels. OCR confidence is an estimate, not a guarantee of correctness.
